name: Minswap
description: Constant-product AMM DEX on Cardano with separate stableswap pools for pegged assets. Largest Cardano DEX by TVL.
notes: Asset list is the most-traded pairs from a GeckoTerminal top-pools-by-TVL snapshot plus the MIN governance token; it is directional, not an exhaustive listing. Minswap also runs a 'Margin' beta whose scope is undocumented, so borrow is not claimed here. Scripts captured from real unsigned transactions on 2026-10-14 and confirmed on chain; a route through a contract not listed here is refused by the signer guard.
